keys.name: agent.ack_persist_interval
keys.doc: acked_seq of an agent consumer is saved at the latest after this interval.

keys.name: agent.ack_timeout
keys.doc: Without an ack within this time the server delivers again from acked_seq + 1 with redelivered.

keys.name: agent.heartbeat_persist_interval
keys.doc: Heartbeat fields are stored at most this often.

keys.name: agent.invocation_token_ttl
keys.doc: Validity of an invocation token.

keys.name: agent.jwks_max_age

keys.name: agent.max_inflight_events
keys.doc: Most unacknowledged events on the way per agent consumer.

keys.name: agent.presence_timeout
keys.doc: Without a heartbeat for this long an agent is offline.

keys.name: api.cors_allowed_origins
keys.doc: Additional origins that get CORS headers; each entry is an origin such as https://app.example.com.

keys.name: api.page_size_default
keys.doc: Page size of a list without limit.

keys.name: api.page_size_max
keys.doc: Largest page size; a larger limit is capped.

keys.name: app.manifest_max_bytes
keys.doc: Largest app manifest in bytes.

keys.name: audit.checkpoint_interval
keys.doc: Interval of the job audit.chain_verify, which recomputes the audit chain and signs the next checkpoint.

keys.name: audit.checkpoint_s3_access_key_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the access key ID of the object store of the audit checkpoints, read only with an s3:// sink.

keys.name: audit.checkpoint_s3_endpoint
keys.doc: Endpoint of the object store of the audit checkpoints, an absolute http or https URL without path, required with an s3:// sink.

keys.name: audit.checkpoint_s3_region
keys.doc: Region of the S3 signature of the object store of the audit checkpoints.

keys.name: audit.checkpoint_s3_secret_key_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the secret access key of the object store of the audit checkpoints, read only with an s3:// sink.

keys.name: audit.checkpoint_s3_use_path_style
keys.doc: Path-style requests to the object store of the audit checkpoints instead of virtual-hosted requests on <bucket>.<endpoint host>.

keys.name: audit.checkpoint_sink
keys.doc: Where the signed audit checkpoints are stored outside the database: empty (a permanent warning), file://<absolute path> on storage outside the database volume, or s3://<bucket>[/<prefix>] in an object store with a retention lock.

keys.name: audit.deny_aggregate_max_keys
keys.doc: Most open aggregations of denials per process; a new key beyond it writes the oldest at once.

keys.name: audit.deny_aggregate_window
keys.doc: Window from the first of identical denials within which they become one audit entry with a count.

keys.name: audit.reason_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest mandatory reason of a management action in Unicode characters.

keys.name: auth.access_token_ttl
keys.doc: Lifetime of an access token.

keys.name: auth.api_token_max_ttl
keys.doc: Longest lifetime of an agent or app token.

keys.name: auth.argon2id_iterations

keys.name: auth.argon2id_memory_kib

keys.name: auth.argon2id_parallelism
keys.doc: Argon2id parallelism of new password hashes.

keys.name: auth.cleanup_interval

keys.name: auth.clock_leeway
keys.doc: Allowed clock skew for exp, nbf and iat.

keys.name: auth.console_session_idle_timeout
keys.doc: Time without a request after which a web console session ends.

keys.name: auth.console_session_max_age
keys.doc: Absolute end of a web console session after its login.

keys.name: auth.device_inactive_revoke_after
keys.doc: An active device without contact for this long is revoked (reason inactive).

keys.name: auth.device_pending_ttl
keys.doc: Age after which a pending device without approval counts as revoked.

keys.name: auth.device_verification_code_digits
keys.doc: Digits of the verification code a pending device shows.

keys.name: auth.dpop_nonce_ttl

keys.name: auth.dpop_proof_max_age
keys.doc: Oldest iat a DPoP proof may have.

keys.name: auth.dpop_required_for

keys.name: auth.enrollment_code_max_attempts

keys.name: auth.enrollment_code_ttl
keys.doc: Validity of an enrollment code from its issue.

keys.name: auth.group_claim_max_age
keys.doc: Expiry of a membership from a group claim after the last OIDC login that carried it.

keys.name: auth.idp_recheck_interval
keys.doc: Age of an OIDC session after which the next refresh needs a new login at the provider.

keys.name: auth.local_password_enabled
keys.doc: Whether a local account may sign in with password and TOTP as fallback.

keys.name: auth.login_fail_limit
keys.doc: Failed password logins of a login name per window before the password path is locked.

keys.name: auth.login_fail_window
keys.doc: Window in which failed attempts count.

keys.name: auth.login_flow_ttl
keys.doc: Validity of an OIDC login flow and of a passkey ceremony (login, enrollment, registration).

keys.name: auth.login_lock_duration
keys.doc: How long the password path of a login name stays locked.

keys.name: auth.oidc_client_assertion_ttl
keys.doc: Lifetime of a private_key_jwt client assertion.

keys.name: auth.oidc_jwks_cache_ttl
keys.doc: Cache of the provider metadata (discovery) and keys (JWKS).

keys.name: auth.pairing_code_chars
keys.doc: Crockford Base32 characters of a pairing code (5 bits each).

keys.name: auth.pairing_code_ttl
keys.doc: Validity of a pairing code, and the window to collect an approved pairing.

keys.name: auth.password_min_length
keys.doc: Shortest local password in Unicode code points after NFC.

keys.name: auth.personal_token_max_ttl
keys.doc: Longest lifetime of a personal token.

keys.name: auth.refresh_reuse_grace
keys.doc: Grace for the refresh generation just before the current one with the same DPoP key.

keys.name: auth.refresh_token_ttl
keys.doc: Lifetime of a refresh token, never beyond the end of its session.

keys.name: auth.server_code_ttl
keys.doc: Validity of the one-time login_code of the OIDC callback.

keys.name: auth.session_max_age
keys.doc: Absolute end of an app session after its start; then a new login.

keys.name: auth.step_up_challenge_ttl
keys.doc: How long a step-up challenge may be completed.

keys.name: auth.step_up_fail_limit
keys.doc: Failed step-ups of a session per auth.login_fail_window; then the session is revoked.

keys.name: auth.step_up_max_age
keys.doc: How long a step-up confirmation counts as fresh for actions that need one.

keys.name: auth.token_pepper_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the server pepper for the HMAC hashes of tokens and codes and the DPoP nonce key; 32 bytes as hex.

keys.name: auth.totp_key_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the AES-256 key that encrypts the TOTP secrets; 32 bytes as hex.

keys.name: auth.trusted_header_bind_requests
keys.doc: Every later request of a session started with the trusted_header driver must carry the same header login.

keys.name: auth.webauthn_origins
keys.doc: Allowed origins of the passkeys; empty means the origin of server.public_url; entries may be app origins such as android:apk-key-hash:...

keys.name: auth.webauthn_rp_id
keys.doc: RP ID of the passkeys; empty means the host of server.public_url (an IP address there means no passkeys).

keys.name: authz.expiry_reminder_lead
keys.doc: How long before an expiry the reminder access.expiring is written.

keys.name: authz.expiry_sweep_batch_max
keys.doc: Rows per transaction of the jobs authz.expiry_sweep and authz.expiry_reminder.

keys.name: authz.expiry_sweep_interval
keys.doc: Period of the jobs that report expired grants and memberships and send reminders before an expiry.

keys.name: authz.snapshot_cache_max_entries
keys.doc: Most rights snapshots a process keeps in memory (least recently used go first).

keys.name: authz.view_as_max_duration
keys.doc: Longest duration of view as: from its start plus this duration every decision of the view is step_up_required.

keys.name: backup.logical.retention
keys.doc: How long the snapshots of the logical backup are kept.

keys.name: backup.logical.schedule
keys.doc: Five-field cron schedule in UTC of the logical backup with pg_dump.

keys.name: backup.objects.retention
keys.doc: How long the snapshots of the object backup are kept.

keys.name: backup.objects.schedule
keys.doc: Five-field cron schedule in UTC of the object backup.

keys.name: backup.offsite.region
keys.doc: Region of the S3 off-site target.

keys.name: backup.offsite.target
keys.doc: Off-site target s3:https://<host>[:<port>]/<bucket>[/<prefix>]; empty means local backup only.

keys.name: backup.offsite.use_path_style
keys.doc: Whether the off-site target is addressed path-style instead of by bucket host name.

keys.name: backup.pg.diff_schedule
keys.doc: Five-field cron schedule in UTC of the differential pgBackRest backup.

keys.name: backup.pg.full_schedule
keys.doc: Five-field cron schedule in UTC of the full pgBackRest backup.

keys.name: backup.pg.local_retention_full
keys.doc: Number of full backups kept in the local repository repo1.

keys.name: backup.pg.retention_full
keys.doc: Number of full backups kept in the off-site repository repo2.

keys.name: billing.mismatch_alert_after
keys.doc: How long the reported mode may differ from the configured one before the warning and the alarm.

keys.name: branding.product_name_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest product name of the branding in Unicode characters.

keys.name: channel.history_backfill_limit_default
keys.doc: history_backfill_limit of a new channel; at most channel.history_backfill_limit_max.

keys.name: channel.history_backfill_limit_max
keys.doc: Upper bound of history_backfill_limit.

keys.name: channel.name_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest channel name in Unicode characters.

keys.name: channel.prompt_max_bytes
keys.doc: Longest channel prompt in bytes of UTF-8 (putChannelBehavior, M2-02).

keys.name: channel.topic_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest channel topic in Unicode characters.

keys.name: client.min_version.android
keys.doc: Lowest app version allowed to connect on this platform; empty means no bound.

keys.name: client.min_version.ios
keys.doc: Lowest app version allowed to connect on this platform; empty means no bound.

keys.name: client.min_version.macos
keys.doc: Lowest app version allowed to connect on this platform; empty means no bound.

keys.name: client.min_version.windows
keys.doc: Lowest app version allowed to connect on this platform; empty means no bound.

keys.name: client.recommended_version.android
keys.doc: App version below which the app shows an update note on this platform; empty means none.

keys.name: client.recommended_version.ios
keys.doc: App version below which the app shows an update note on this platform; empty means none.

keys.name: client.recommended_version.macos
keys.doc: App version below which the app shows an update note on this platform; empty means none.

keys.name: client.recommended_version.windows
keys.doc: App version below which the app shows an update note on this platform; empty means none.

keys.name: command.description_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest command description in characters.

keys.name: command.max_per_principal
keys.doc: Most commands of one agent or app.

keys.name: consumer.batch_size
keys.doc: Events per round of a worker consumer.

keys.name: consumer.pending_alert_after
keys.doc: Age of the oldest unprocessed event of a worker consumer that raises the alarm; strictly below sync.event_retention.

keys.name: consumer.poll_interval
keys.doc: How often a worker consumer runs a round without a notification.

keys.name: database.acquire_timeout
keys.doc: How long a request waits for a pool connection before it gets 503 unavailable.

keys.name: database.host
keys.doc: Host name or address of the database, or the directory of its Unix socket when it starts with a slash.

keys.name: database.idle_in_tx_timeout
keys.doc: How long an open transaction may sit without work before the database ends the session.

keys.name: database.listen_reconnect_backoff_cap
keys.doc: Longest pause between attempts to reconnect the LISTEN connection.

keys.name: database.lock_timeout
keys.doc: How long a statement waits for a lock.

keys.name: database.max_conns
keys.doc: Size of the connection pool of each process.

keys.name: database.name
keys.doc: Name of the database.

keys.name: database.password_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the password of database.user, read again for every new connection.

keys.name: database.port
keys.doc: Port of the database in the network of the server.

keys.name: database.sslmode
keys.doc: TLS to the database: verify-full, or disable only inside the internal Compose network (SEC-TLS-5).

keys.name: database.sslrootcert
keys.doc: PEM file with the CA certificates for verify-full; empty uses the system roots.

keys.name: database.statement_timeout
keys.doc: Deadline of a single SQL statement, overridable per transaction.

keys.name: database.tx_retry_max
keys.doc: Retries of a unit of work after a deadlock or a lock timeout.

keys.name: database.user

keys.name: egress.allowed_hosts
keys.doc: Additional allowed targets of outgoing connections, each host[:port][;allow_private]; allow_private also opens private addresses and plain http.

keys.name: egress.max_response_bytes

keys.name: egress.timeout
keys.doc: Time limit of one outgoing request, from name resolution to the end of the body.

keys.name: file.denied_mime_types
keys.doc: Media types refused at upload, by declared type and by file extension; empty refuses none.

keys.name: file.fs.min_free_bytes
keys.doc: Free space the file system driver keeps; an upload that would leave less is refused with 503 storage_full.

keys.name: file.fs.root
keys.doc: Root directory of the file system driver, used only by the server and owned by its user with mode 0700.

keys.name: file.max_upload_bytes
keys.doc: Largest file, and the stream limit of multipart and octet-stream request bodies.

keys.name: file.name_max_bytes
keys.doc: Longest file name in UTF-8 bytes; longer names are shortened before their extension.

keys.name: file.quota_bytes_per_principal
keys.doc: Bytes of files one principal may keep; 0 switches the quota off.

keys.name: file.s3.access_key_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the S3 access key ID, read only with the driver s3.

keys.name: file.s3.bucket

keys.name: file.s3.checksum_mode
keys.doc: When the S3 SDK computes and checks its own checksums for requests and responses.

keys.name: file.s3.endpoint
keys.doc: Endpoint of the S3-compatible service, an absolute http or https URL without path, required with the driver s3.

keys.name: file.s3.prefix
keys.doc: Optional prefix in the key grammar before every object name, so one bucket can hold several environments.

keys.name: file.s3.presigned_upload

keys.name: file.s3.region
keys.doc: Region of the S3 signature.

keys.name: file.s3.secret_key_ref

keys.name: file.s3.use_path_style

keys.name: file.upload_max_open_sessions

keys.name: file.upload_part_bytes

keys.name: file.upload_session_ttl

keys.name: forum_tag.name_max_chars

keys.name: group.name_max_chars

keys.name: host.name_max_chars

keys.name: host.os_user_max_chars

keys.name: http.max_header_bytes

keys.name: http.request_timeout

keys.name: http.transfer_timeout

keys.name: http.unavailable_retry_after

keys.name: identity.last_active_granularity

keys.name: instance.environment

keys.name: jobs.queue.delivery.max_workers

keys.name: reaction.max_distinct_per_message
keys.doc: Most distinct emoji per message; bounds Message.reactions and the event payloads.

keys.name: retention.audit
keys.doc: How long the audit log is kept before it is trimmed with an anchor.

keys.name: search.languages
keys.doc: Text search configurations every search query is built with, besides simple.

keys.name: search.locale_map
keys.doc: Text search configuration of new messages and threads per first language subtag of the author's locale.

keys.name: secrets.cache_ttl
keys.doc: How long a secret that was read stays in use before it is read again.

keys.name: secrets.dir
keys.doc: Base directory of the default file: references of secrets.

keys.name: secrets.signing_key_dir
keys.doc: Writable directory of the private signing keys; owned by the service user with mode 0700.

keys.name: server.internal_listen_addr
keys.doc: Address of the internal listener for health, readiness and incoming webhooks from services in the stack.

keys.name: server.listen_addr
keys.doc: Address of the public listener that serves REST and the gateway.

keys.name: server.public_url
keys.doc: Origin under which apps reach the server; the base of the DPoP htu, token audience and WebAuthn.

keys.name: server.role
keys.doc: Role of the process: api serves REST and the gateway, worker runs jobs and consumers, all does both.

keys.name: server.tls_cert_ref
keys.doc: Reference to the PEM certificate chain, leaf first; empty means the server terminates no TLS.

keys.name: server.tls_key_ref
keys.doc: Reference to the PEM private key of the certificate; only together with server.tls_cert_ref.

keys.name: server.trusted_proxies
keys.doc: Peers whose forwarding and identity headers count and that may send plaintext.

keys.name: shutdown.drain_delay
keys.doc: Wait after readiness turns false, so the proxy stops sending new requests.

keys.name: shutdown.http_grace
keys.doc: Time running HTTP requests get to finish during the shutdown.

keys.name: shutdown.jobs_soft_timeout
keys.doc: Time running jobs get to finish during the shutdown before their contexts are cancelled.

keys.name: shutdown.telemetry_flush_timeout
keys.doc: Time the shutdown gives telemetry to export what it still holds.

keys.name: shutdown.total_timeout
keys.doc: Whole budget of the shutdown; at least the sum of the step budgets, and the orchestrator waits longer.

keys.name: signing_key.accept_lost_keys
keys.doc: Lets a start whose key store holds none of the unretired signing keys retire them and create fresh ones.

keys.name: signing_key.access_token_rotation_interval
keys.doc: Scheduled rotation of the signing key of access tokens.

keys.name: signing_key.cache_ttl
keys.doc: Longest time a process still accepts a withdrawn signing key or does not know a new one.

keys.name: signing_key.invocation_rotation_interval
keys.doc: Scheduled rotation of the signing key of invocation tokens.

keys.name: signing_key.rotation_check_interval
keys.doc: Interval of the job instance.key_rotation.

keys.name: space.name_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest space name in Unicode characters.

keys.name: startup.dependency_wait
keys.doc: How long the start and bothy migrate wait for the database before they give up.

keys.name: sync.catchup_max_events
keys.doc: A client further behind the head than this many events gets resync_required with too_far_behind.

keys.name: sync.catchup_page_size
keys.doc: Events per catch-up page; the default and the largest limit of GET /api/v1/events.

keys.name: sync.cursor_advance_every
keys.doc: Skipped events after which the gateway sends a cursor frame (catch-up and live).

keys.name: sync.event_log_partition_size
keys.doc: Sequence numbers per partition of event_log.

keys.name: sync.event_log_partitions_ahead
keys.doc: Partitions of event_log that stand ready above the head.

keys.name: sync.event_payload_max_bytes
keys.doc: The payload of an event must be smaller than this many bytes; larger objects get a reduced payload.

keys.name: sync.event_retention
keys.doc: How long durable events stay available for catch-up before their partition is detached.

keys.name: sync.heartbeat_interval
keys.doc: Interval of the client's heartbeats, announced in hello.

keys.name: sync.heartbeat_miss_limit
keys.doc: Missed heartbeats after which the gateway closes with 4009.

keys.name: sync.idempotency_cleanup_batch_size
keys.doc: Rows per delete batch of the job sync.idempotency_cleanup.

keys.name: sync.idempotency_cleanup_interval
keys.doc: Interval of the job sync.idempotency_cleanup.

keys.name: sync.idempotency_key_ttl
keys.doc: How long an Idempotency-Key and its stored response stay valid per principal.

keys.name: sync.identify_timeout
keys.doc: Time between hello and identify or resume; without either the gateway closes with 4003.

keys.name: sync.log_poll_interval
keys.doc: How often the log tail reads event_log without a notification.

keys.name: sync.max_focused_threads
keys.doc: Threads a gateway connection may focus; a focus with more answers validation_failed.

keys.name: sync.outbound_queue_max
keys.doc: Frames in the outbound queue of a gateway connection before it closes with 4014.

keys.name: sync.partition_maintenance_interval
keys.doc: Interval of the job sync.partition_maintenance.

keys.name: sync.reauth_lead_time
keys.doc: Lead time of reauth_required before a person's access token expires.

keys.name: sync.resume_window
keys.doc: How long a gateway session stays resumable after its connection ended.

keys.name: sync.tail_batch_size
keys.doc: Events per read of the log tail.

keys.name: sync.typing_min_interval
keys.doc: Shortest interval between two typing.started fan-outs of one connection and thread.

keys.name: sync.typing_ttl
keys.doc: How long a typing indicator lasts without renewal (expires_at of typing.started).

keys.name: sync.ws_max_frame_bytes
keys.doc: Largest WebSocket frame of the gateway; a larger one closes the connection with 4002.

keys.name: telemetry.enabled
keys.doc: Turns the OTLP export of traces, metrics and logs on or off; logs then go to stdout.

keys.name: telemetry.logs.exporter
keys.doc: Where logs go: OTLP to the collector, JSON on stdout, or both.

keys.name: telemetry.logs.level
keys.doc: Lowest level that is written.

keys.name: telemetry.pseudonym_key_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the key for HMAC pseudonyms of people in telemetry; at least 32 bytes.

keys.name: telemetry.traces.sampler_ratio
keys.doc: Share of new traces the SDK records; the collector samples again after that.

keys.name: telemetry.traces.trust_remote_parent
keys.doc: With true an incoming traceparent becomes the parent of the server span, otherwise only a span link.

keys.name: template.max_per_scope
keys.doc: Most templates per person or per channel; listTemplates is not paginated.

keys.name: template.name_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest template name in Unicode characters.

keys.name: terminal.fingerprint_confirm_chars
keys.doc: Characters of the fingerprint the owner types at the confirmation of a host.

keys.name: terminal.fingerprint_max_attempts
keys.doc: Failed confirmations of a host before it falls back to pairing.

keys.name: terminal.host_auth_timeout
keys.doc: Time between hello and identify on the control and data connections of a host service.

keys.name: terminal.host_duplicate_probe_timeout
keys.doc: Time the server waits for the answer of the older control connection of a host (24 section 3.4).

keys.name: terminal.host_heartbeat_interval
keys.doc: Interval of the heartbeats of the control connection of a host service, announced in hello.

keys.name: terminal.host_heartbeat_miss_limit
keys.doc: Missed heartbeats after which the server closes the control connection with 4009.

keys.name: terminal.pairing_code_ttl
keys.doc: Validity of the pairing code of a host.

keys.name: terminal.quick_reattach_window
keys.doc: Reattaching from the same device needs no new step-up within this time after the detachment.

keys.name: terminal.report_label_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest profile name, display name, working directory label and OS version a host reports, in characters.

keys.name: terminal.report_max_entries
keys.doc: Most entries of each list a host reports: profiles, session users, working directories of one session user.

keys.name: terminal.session_token_ttl
keys.doc: Validity of a session token of the terminal.

keys.name: terminal.step_up_max_age
keys.doc: How young the step-up of terminal.open and terminal.attach must be.

keys.name: thread.max_tags
keys.doc: Most forum tags of one thread.

keys.name: thread.placeholder_titles
keys.doc: Placeholder titles: a new thread with such a title keeps title_source auto.

keys.name: thread.title_max_chars
keys.doc: Longest thread title in Unicode characters.

keys.name: voice.max_duration
keys.doc: Longest voice message.

keys.name: webhook.allowed_hosts
keys.doc: Targets an app manifest may name in its delivery addresses and outgoing webhooks may reach: entries host[:port], the host compared without regard to case, without a port only 443.

keys.name: webhook.delivery_timeout
keys.doc: Time limit of one webhook delivery.

keys.name: webhook.hmac_master_key_ref
keys.doc: Secret reference of the master key from which the HMAC secrets of the subscriptions are derived.

keys.name: webhook.max_consecutive_failures
keys.doc: Failures in a row after which a subscription is disabled.

keys.name: webhook.max_pending_per_subscription
keys.doc: Open deliveries per subscription; reaching it pauses the subscription.

keys.name: webhook.retry_backoff_base
keys.doc: Base of the backoff between delivery attempts.

keys.name: webhook.retry_backoff_cap
keys.doc: Largest backoff between delivery attempts.

keys.name: webhook.retry_max_age
keys.doc: Time after which a failing delivery is dead and its subscription disabled.

keys.name: webhook.secret_rotation_overlap
keys.doc: How long the server signs with the old and the new HMAC generation after a rotation.
